body: Nausea the first two weeks, then it settled down once I started taking it with dinner instead of on an empty stomach. Now I barely notice it.
Loose stools for about a month. My pharmacist said that's common early on. It did get better, but I plan my mornings around it.
Honestly no side effects for me except less appetite. I eat smaller meals now and don't feel hungry between them.
Upset stomach if I take it without food. With a snack it's fine. I learned that the hard way after a week of heartburn.
Works for my knee but I get a headache the next morning sometimes, which feels backwards. Drinking more water seemed to help.
A little dizziness when I stand up fast on the days I use it. Goes away in a few seconds. Mentioned it at my clinic visit and they made a note.
I bruise more easily now, big purple ones from bumps I don't even remember. My clinic said to mention any that show up for no reason.
Nosebleeds a couple of times when the air got dry. The blood check appointments are a hassle when the clinic is 40 minutes away, but they matter.
Gums bleed a bit when I brush. Switched to a softer toothbrush and it's better. Nothing else so far, just careful with cuts in the kitchen.
Dry cough that wouldn't quit. Tickly, worse at night, no cold or anything. Turns out it's a known thing with this one, so I brought it up at my next visit.
Lightheaded for the first few days, especially getting out of bed. I sit on the edge for a minute now before standing. It faded after a week.
Mild headache the first week and then nothing. Blood pressure numbers came down, which my clinic was happy about. The cough people mention never hit me.
Nausea and a jittery feeling the first ten days or so. It settled. Sleep was rough at first too, then it evened out around week three.
Vivid dreams and less appetite. Mood is steadier than it's been in a long while, which is why I'm sticking with it and telling my clinic how it's going.
Some stomach upset and yawning a lot the first couple of weeks. Both eased off. Taking it in the morning worked better for my sleep than at night.
Swollen ankles by the end of the day, especially after standing at work. Putting my feet up in the evening helps. My clinic knows and is keeping an eye on it.
Felt flushed and a bit dizzy the first week, like I'd had a glass of wine. It passed. Now the only thing I notice is I sleep a little lighter.
Achy calves for a few weeks that I first blamed on walking more. Mentioned it at my visit and they ran a blood test, which came back fine. The aches faded on their own.
No side effects that I can tell, other than some mild headaches early on. I take it at night because that's what the bottle says and it's easy to remember with brushing my teeth.
Heartburn is gone, which is a relief. I did get a headache and some gas the first couple of weeks. My pharmacist said to take it before breakfast, which seemed to help my stomach settle.
